title: Dell launches the student laptop 14S with Intel Wildcat Lake, up to 21 hours of battery and four colors to compete with the MacBook Neo
summary: The 14-inch ultralight arrives in various configurations, standing out for its autonomy, ports, and aluminum design, positioning itself as an alternative to Apple laptops.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 with significant improvements in research and programming
summary: The new model raises its performance in scientific tasks from 24.7% to 52.6% and in programming from 42% to 55.8%, reducing cache costs and restrictions.

title: Modders create tools to use DLSS 5 in any game after NVIDIA's refusal to allow forcing it
summary: The community develops 'DLSS 5 Swapper' and analyzes initial performance, revealing limits of the 12V-2x6 connector on the RTX 5090 while NVIDIA blocks official override.

title: Acer presents an offensive of gaming laptops and handheld consoles: Predator Atlas 7, DualPlay Mini and Swift Blade 14
summary: The brand reveals devices with 120 Hz screens, Intel Arc graphics, and convertible designs, seeking to challenge Steam Deck and ASUS ROG Ally in the handheld market.

title: U.S. backs OpenAI in copyright lawsuits over AI training
summary: The Trump administration and the Department of Justice argue that the use of protected material to train models constitutes fair use, aligning with OpenAI against the New York Times.

title: Google avoids breakup of its advertising business but must change its practices
summary: A judge rules that Google will not be broken up, but orders modifications to its advertising operation following an antitrust lawsuit.

title: Massive leak of 153 million driver's licenses in U.S. and Canada linked to an identity verification service
summary: The FBI investigates a breach in an identity authentication provider that exposed data of officials, including the Secretary of Defense, on a Russian forum.

title: Pangram establishes itself as gold standard in AI detection, but doubts arise about its reliability
summary: The AI-generated text detection tool gains recognition, although experts debate whether its approach is sufficient to distinguish synthetic content.

title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third budget model in six weeks, while frontier models remain absent
summary: The rapid succession of lightweight Gemini versions contrasts with the absence of updates in the most advanced models, generating speculation about Google's strategy.

title: GoPro sells for $285 million and will pivot toward AI data centers and defense
summary: The stock once worth $12 billion is acquired by an optical photonics company, with plans to move manufacturing to the U.S. and reconvert the business.

title: Alienware debuts 32-inch QD-OLED monitors 4K 165 Hz and 560 Hz 1080p for demanding gamers
summary: Dell expands its gaming line with high-speed and pixel-density panels, offering options for both resolution and extreme refresh rate.
